checks.describe: importlib.metadata's own entry_points() lookup -- not just pyproject.toml text -- resolves the platformops console script to platformops.cli:app, proving the installed shim's mapping is real, not just declared
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && uv run python3 -c "from importlib.metadata import entry_points; eps = entry_points(group='console_scripts'); m = [e for e in eps if e.name == 'platformops']; print(m[0].value if m else 'MISSING')"

checks.describe: piping a failing validate into another command reports pipeline exit 0 without set -o pipefail -- the gotcha section 3 demonstrates
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && bash -c 'uv run platformops validate service-bad.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l > /dev/null; echo "EXIT:$?"'

checks.describe: the same pipeline with set -o pipefail correctly surfaces validate's real exit code 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.6 && bash -c 'set -o pipefail; uv run platformops validate service-bad.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l > /dev/null; echo "EXIT:$?"'
